title: German auction house urged to cancel sale of Holocaust artefacts
summary: Survivors group calls on firm Felzmann to ‘show some basic decency’ and halt the ‘cynical and shameless’ event A Holocaust survivors group is calling on a German auction house to cancel a sale of hundreds of Holocaust artefacts, including letters written by prisoners and other documents that identify many people by name. The International Auschwitz Committee, a Berlin-based group, called the “cynical and shameless” sale with a title of the System of Terror to be stopped. It is scheduled to be held on Monday by the Felzmann auction house. Continue reading...

title: BBC should not pay Trump any money, says former BBC director general
summary: Tony Hall says it’s not ‘appropriate’ to pay US president with licence fee payer’s money after he threatened to sue broadcaster for up to $5bn The BBC should not pay any money to Donald Trump, the former BBC director general Tony Hall has said. The US president has said he plans to sue the BBC for up to $5bn (£3.8bn) despite receiving the apology he demanded over a misleading Panorama edit of his 6 January speech. Continue reading...

title: New York Jets player Kris Boyd in critical condition after being shot in abdomen
summary: 29-year-old was shot after incident in Midtown Police say dispute outside restaurant turned violent New York Jets player Kris Boyd is in a critical situation in hospital after being shot in the early hours of Sunday morning. The NYPD said the 29-year-old was shot in the abdomen around 2am on West 38th street in Midtown. He was taken to Bellevue Hospital, where he is in critical but stable condition. Continue reading...

title: Somalia confirms major data breach in electronic visa system
summary: Officials launch probe days after breach emerged amid widespread concern and speculation over leaked data.
